camel_example: aliyun eventbridge ListLumaNamespaces --region cn-hangzhou --AgentName my_agent --Catalog my_catalog

Catalog.description_en: The name of the data catalog to which the namespace belongs
Catalog.description_zh: 命名空间所属的数据目录名称
Catalog.title: 所属数据目录

Comment.description_en: The description information of the namespace
Comment.description_zh: 命名空间的备注描述信息
Comment.title: 备注描述

Name.description_en: The unique identifier name of the namespace
Name.description_zh: 命名空间的唯一标识名称
Name.title: 命名空间名称

properties.description_en: The extended properties of the namespace
properties.title: 扩展属性

description_en: Lists all namespaces bound to a Luma Agent under a specified data catalog. Returns the complete set of bindings without pagination
description_zh: 列出 Luma Agent 在指定数据目录下绑定的全部命名空间。返回的是绑定关系的全集，不分页
kebab_example: aliyun eventbridge list-luma-namespaces --agent-name my_agent --catalog my_catalog --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLumaNamespaces

parameters.help_en: The name of the data catalog bound to the agent. You can call the ListLumaCatalogs operation to obtain the catalog name
parameters.help_zh: Agent 已绑定的数据目录名称。可通过 ListLumaCatalogs 获取
parameters.name: catalog

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100. Each entry requires a back-to-origin metadata query, so this value also limits the number of back-to-origin requests per call
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的最大数据条数。取值范围 1~100，不传时默认 100。每条记录都需回源查询一次元数据，因此该值同时限制单次调用的回源次数
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token for the paging query. Leave this parameter empty or set it to "0" for the first query. For subsequent pages, use the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询的起始Token。首次查询不传或传 "0"；后续翻页使用上一次响应中返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

Code.description_en: The response code. A value of Success indicates a successful operation. If the operation fails, a specific error code is returned
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功，失败时为具体错误码
Code.title_en: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功
Code.title_zh: 接口返回码，Success 表示成功

Data.description_en: The list of namespaces bound to the agent, including entries and pagination information
Data.description_zh: Agent 绑定的命名空间列表，包含条目与分页信息

Limit.description_en: The effective page size for this request. If the Limit parameter is not specified, the server default value is used. If the specified value exceeds the upper limit, the value is adjusted to the maximum allowed value
Limit.description_zh: 本次请求实际生效的每页数量。未传 Limit 时为服务端默认值，超出上限时为收敛后的值
Limit.title_en: 本次请求实际生效的每页数量
Limit.title_zh: 本次请求实际生效的每页数量

Namespaces.description_en: The list of namespaces bound to the agent
Namespaces.description_zh: Agent 绑定的命名空间列表

items.description_zh: 单个命名空间的详细信息

NextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. Pass this value as the NextToken parameter in the next request to retrieve the next page. An empty value indicates that no more data is available
NextToken.description_zh: 下一页起始Token，传入下次请求的 NextToken 可获取下一页；为空表示已无更多数据
NextToken.title_en: 下一页Token，为空表示已是最后一页
NextToken.title_zh: 下一页Token，为空表示已是最后一页

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of namespaces bound to the agent, regardless of the number of entries returned on the current page
TotalCount.description_zh: Agent 绑定的命名空间总数，与本页返回条数无关
TotalCount.title_en: Agent 绑定的命名空间总数
TotalCount.title_zh: Agent 绑定的命名空间总数

Message.description_en: The response message. A value of Operation success is returned if the operation succeeds. A specific error description is returned if the operation fails
Message.description_zh: 接口返回的提示信息，成功时为 Operation success，失败时为具体错误描述

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. Use this ID for troubleshooting and when submitting a ticket
RequestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于问题排查与工单反馈

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. A value of true indicates success
Success.description_zh: 本次调用是否成功，true 表示成功
